title: Tesla Releases Update: Doubo Large Model Voice Assistant Expands to More Models, Over a Dozen Features Upgraded

content_html:
Tesla has started rolling out the 2026.26.200.11 software update, bringing the Doubao large model voice assistant to more vehicle models. This in-car voice assistant requires ordering the premium in-car entertainment service to use, and it offers multiple voice tones and character options - car owners can choose a pleasant-sounding voice as a co-pilot.

Aside from the voice assistant, this update covers a wide range of features. The pet mode now supports custom pet information and optimized display; both the blind spot warning ambient light and door opening warning functions have been upgraded. The "Trip" feature has been moved into the "Energy" app, and the range estimate now takes battery aging into account; navigation has added a "Familiar Route" feature that adapts to daily driving habits. In terms of update methods, it supports automatic installation at night, and there is a welcome animation when starting up.

There are also many changes in entertainment and details: the dash cam can permanently save local short videos; the whiteboard has added stickers and emojis and supports synchronization with a mobile phone; the rear screen can synchronize navigation and display lyrics. The camera preview can be opened without parking. The browser can use the interior camera and microphone while parked. The auxiliary driving visualization zoom supports customization. A new parental control feature has been added, and media application login can send notifications. Apple Music operations have been optimized. In addition, traction control now has three new modes, the window opening angle after a collision has increased, the map package has been updated, and several security vulnerabilities have been fixed.
